homeSections.title: Language Guru — India's Premier Translation Agency
homeSections.content:
Language Guru is a one-stop language translation and interpretation service provider founded in 2005 and headquartered in New Delhi. We deliver ISO-9001:2015 and ISO 17100:2015 certified translations across 120+ world languages with accuracy, speed and full embassy and government acceptance.

We serve clients across India — Delhi NCR, Mumbai, Chennai, Bangalore, Pune, Hyderabad, Kolkata — and 150+ other cities. Our government-authorized, MSME-registered agency is trusted by law firms, hospitals, universities, corporates and embassies.

Every translation goes through a two-step quality process: a qualified native-speaking translator followed by an independent proofreader, under our ISO quality-management framework. All documents are handled under signed NDAs.

homeSections.title: Legal Translation Services in Delhi
homeSections.content:
We provide legal document translation to government agencies, law firms, corporates and individuals. Our legal translators understand legal terminology in both the source and target language, and work under strict NDAs.

Expertise covers court orders, business contracts, partnership agreements, judgments, property papers, affidavits, powers of attorney, wills, patents and trademark filings across 120+ languages. Apostille and attestation are available under the same roof.

homeSections.title: Certified Translation Services
homeSections.content:
ISO-9001:2015 and ISO 17100:2015 certified translations accepted by embassies, consulates, courts and government offices worldwide. Each translation includes a signed translator declaration on official letterhead, making it embassy-ready without additional certification.

Our certified translators are native speakers and qualified professionals trained in legal, medical, technical and academic terminology, with delivery as fast as 24 hours.

homeSections.title: Expert & Qualified Interpreter Services
homeSections.content:
Multilingual interpretation across India for businesses, legal proceedings, medical consultations, government bodies and academic institutions. Our interpreters are certified subject-matter experts.

We cover simultaneous, consecutive, telephone and escort interpretation in 120+ language pairs, and provide equipment including booths, receivers and microphones for large events. Remote video and telephone interpretation is available for urgent requirements.

homeSections.title: Document Translation Services in Delhi
homeSections.content:
We convert your most important documents — personal, academic, legal, medical, financial and corporate — into 120+ languages with precision, formatting integrity and full embassy and government acceptance.

From a single birth certificate to thousands of pages of contracts, every document is reviewed by a second linguist and issued with our ISO certification reference and a signed translator declaration.

pages.title: Terms of Service
pages.content:
By commissioning translation, interpretation, attestation or apostille work from us, you agree to the terms below. Please read them before placing an order.

1. Services Provided

We provide professional translation, interpretation, apostille, attestation and related language services in line with ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17100:2015 standards.

2. Quotes and Payment

Quotes are based on the material supplied. Rates are indicative until the source documents have been reviewed, and may vary by language pair, document type, complexity and page count. Payment or a deposit is required before work begins unless a corporate account is in place.

3. Turnaround

Delivery dates are agreed per project. Express service is available for most language pairs at an additional charge. Delays caused by illegible source material or late clarifications may move the delivery date.

4. Confidentiality

All documents and information are treated as confidential. Our translators and staff are bound by non-disclosure agreements.

5. Acceptance by Third Parties

Our certified translations are prepared to meet standard embassy, court and university requirements. Requirements vary by authority, country and purpose, so final acceptance rests with the receiving authority. Tell us the specific requirement and we will prepare the translation to match it.

6. Revisions and Liability

We correct any error in our work free of charge. Beyond that remedy, our liability is limited to the value of the affected order, and we are not liable for indirect or consequential loss.

7. Governing Law

These terms are governed by the laws of India, and disputes fall under the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of New Delhi.
pages.metaDesc: The terms governing translation, interpretation, attestation and apostille services provided by Language Guru.

pages.title: Privacy Policy
pages.content:
We are committed to protecting your privacy and the confidentiality of every document you send us. This policy explains what we collect, why, and how it is protected.

1. Information We Collect

We collect the name, email address, phone number and city you provide when requesting a quote or contacting us, together with any documents you submit for translation. We collect nothing that is not needed to deliver the service.

2. How We Use Your Information

Your information is used to prepare quotes, deliver translations, and communicate about your project. We do not sell, rent or share your personal information with third parties for marketing.

3. Document Confidentiality

Every translator and member of staff works under a signed non-disclosure agreement. Documents are handled in line with our ISO 9001:2015 and ISO 17100:2015 information-security procedures and are retained only as long as needed for delivery and quality records.

4. Data Security

We apply industry-standard technical and organisational measures to protect your data against unauthorised access, alteration or disclosure.

5. Your Rights

You may ask us what personal data we hold about you, request a correction, or request deletion once your project and its retention period are complete.

6. Contact

For any question about this policy or about how your data is handled, contact us using the details on our contact page.

items.desc: Professional simultaneous and consecutive interpretation for international conferences, summits, seminars and corporate events across India. Our conference interpreters are trained in ISO-standard booth protocols and work in teams of two for events longer than an hour, so accuracy never drops due to fatigue. We cover 120+ language pairs including German, French, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic and Spanish, and complete audio equipment — booths, receivers and headsets — can be arranged on request. From diplomatic summits to product launches, Language Guru has supported 2,000+ events since 2005.
items.label: 🎤 Conference
items.title: Conference & Simultaneous Interpretation

items.desc: Certified court interpreters for legal proceedings, arbitrations, depositions, police interviews and immigration hearings. Every legal interpreter on our panel is court-experienced and understands procedural terminology in both languages, so testimony is rendered precisely without summarising or omission. We regularly assist law firms, embassies and government agencies across Delhi NCR and India. All engagements are covered by strict NDAs, and sworn or affidavit-backed interpretation certificates can be issued wherever the court requires them. Same-day emergency assignments are routinely handled.
items.label: ⚖️ Legal
items.title: Legal & Court Interpretation

items.desc: Specialist patient-interpreter services for hospitals, clinics, medical tourism providers and clinical research organisations. Our medical interpreters are trained in anatomy, pharmacology and consent-process terminology, enabling clear doctor-patient communication during consultations, surgery counselling and follow-ups. India is a major medical tourism destination, and we routinely support Arabic, Russian, French and Bengali speaking patients at leading hospitals in Delhi, Gurgaon and Chennai. Every assignment is HIPAA and DPDP compliant with complete patient confidentiality, and male or female interpreters can be requested.
items.label: 🏥 Medical
items.title: Medical & Healthcare Interpretation

items.desc: Professional business interpreters for negotiations, board meetings, factory audits, trade shows and corporate presentations. Our interpreters combine language mastery with real industry knowledge — manufacturing, IT, pharma, finance — so technical discussions flow naturally without losing nuance. We have supported Indo-German machine installations, Indo-Japanese joint ventures and Chinese supplier audits across Delhi NCR, Pune and Chennai. Interpreters can travel with your team anywhere in India for multi-day, multi-city assignments, and every corporate engagement includes a signed NDA as standard practice.
items.label: 💼 Business
items.title: Business & Corporate Interpretation

items.desc: On-site technical interpreters for machine installation, commissioning, and industrial projects — one of our most in-demand services. When foreign engineers (German, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Italian and more) arrive to install or commission machinery, our technical interpreters bridge the communication gap between them and your Indian operations team on the shop floor. They are experienced with engineering terminology, machine manuals, control panels, safety protocols and Factory/Site Acceptance Test (FAT/SAT) procedures, and can be deployed for multi-day and multi-week projects at plants anywhere in India — ensuring installation, trials, operator training and handover happen smoothly without costly misunderstandings.
items.label: ⚙️ Technical
items.title: Technical Interpretation — Machine Installation & Commissioning

items.desc: On-demand over-the-phone (OPI) and video remote interpreting (VRI) in 100+ languages — connect with a professional interpreter without travel costs or scheduling delays. Sessions run over Zoom, Microsoft Teams, Google Meet, Webex or a simple phone call, with average connection time under 60 seconds and 24×7 availability. Ideal for visa interviews, telemedicine consultations, international client calls, online depositions and virtual conferences. Remote interpretation is billed hourly, making it the most economical option, and encrypted lines with optional session recordings keep every call fully confidential.
items.label: 📞 Remote
items.title: Telephone & Remote Interpretation

items.desc: A personal interpreter for the full duration of a visit, delegation or tour — from airport pickup to final departure. We support foreign executives, government and embassy delegations, factory inspection teams and high-net-worth tourists across multi-day, multi-city itineraries anywhere in India. Escort interpreters handle meetings, site visits, cultural outings and even restaurant conversations, while also providing cultural-protocol guidance and etiquette briefings so nothing is lost between languages. For mixed delegations we assemble multi-language teams under a single coordinator for a seamless experience.

items.title: Escort & Liaison Interpretation

From birth certificates to large corporate translation projects, we deliver accurate Arabic translations on time. 24-hour express delivery available across India. Office submission or email / WhatsApp in Delhi NCR.

Our legal Arabic translators are qualified professionals with deep expertise in Indian and international law, court procedures, contract law, immigration regulations and corporate compliance. Every legal Arabic translation is done by a native Arabic-speaking legal specialist and reviewed by a second expert before delivery.

officialParagraphs: Language Guru provides official Arabic translation services accepted by all government bodies, regulatory authorities, embassies and public institutions in India and abroad. Our official Arabic translations carry the full credentials required by government bodies: official company letterhead, certified translator's signature, registration number, contact details, and a sworn statement of accuracy – making them immediately valid for submission to any government department, court, embassy or university.

Official Arabic translation is required for a wide range of purposes: visa and immigration applications, MEA apostille and embassy attestation, court and tribunal submissions, university admissions abroad, government tenders and procurement, and all public notarial acts. Language Guru – MSME registered, ISO-9001:2015 and ISO 17100:2015 certified and operating since 2005 – is one of the few agencies in India authorized to issue officially certified translations accepted by all Indian and foreign government bodies.

We offer official Arabic translations with turnaround as fast as 24 hours, with easy document submission via email / WhatsApp across India and secure courier delivery anywhere in India. All translations include digital (soft copy PDF/Word) and physical (hard copy with stamps) delivery options.
certifiedParagraphs: Language Guru delivers ISO-9001:2015 and ISO 17100:2015 certified Arabic translation services across India. A certified Arabic translation from Language Guru includes: translation on official agency letterhead, certified translator's full name, qualification, signature and stamp, a formal statement of accuracy and completeness, and the agency's MSME registration and ISO certification details. This complete package is the standard required by all embassies, courts, MEA and government departments in India and internationally.

Our certified Arabic translations are prepared exclusively by native Arabic speakers holding recognized translation qualifications (B.A./M.A. in Translation, DipTrans, or equivalent) with minimum 5 years of domain-specific experience. Every certified Arabic translation undergoes a mandatory 3-stage quality check: initial translation by a domain expert, independent review by a second Arabic specialist, and final certification by our Quality Manager. This process ensures 100% accuracy and first-submission acceptance at all embassies and government offices.

Whether you need a single certified Arabic document or a bulk project of 100+ pages anywhere in India, Language Guru offers consistent quality, ISO-standard processes and competitive pricing starting at ₹850/page for certified translations with full letterhead, Certificate of Accuracy and quality certification. Express 24-hour certified Arabic translation is available for urgent requirements.

faqs.question: Are your translations accepted by embassies?
faqs.answer: Yes. Our certified translations are prepared to standard embassy and consular requirements, including the certified seal, Certificate of Accuracy, official letterhead and, where needed, notarization or MEA apostille. Each embassy sets its own rules, so tell us which embassy and purpose and we will match their exact format.

faqs.question: How much does certified translation cost?
faqs.answer: Pricing is per page and depends on the language pair, document type and turnaround. Economy, standard and express tiers are available, and add-ons such as notarization, MEA apostille and embassy attestation are priced separately. GST applies. Use the instant quote form for an exact price on your documents.

faqs.question: How long does translation take?
faqs.answer: Standard certified translation takes 3–5 working days. Express 24-hour delivery is available for common language pairs, and large projects of 50+ pages typically take 7–10 days. Urgent same-day service can be arranged on WhatsApp.

faqs.question: How do I submit my documents?
faqs.answer: Submit at our Delhi office, or send scanned copies by email or WhatsApp from anywhere in India. We return soft copies by email and courier hard copies to any PIN code on request.

faqs.question: Can I get translation into any Indian regional language?
faqs.answer: Yes. We cover all 22 scheduled Indian languages including Hindi, Bengali, Tamil, Telugu, Marathi, Gujarati, Kannada, Malayalam, Punjabi, Odia, Urdu and Assamese, plus many regional languages beyond that list.

faqs.question: Which translation service do I need?
faqs.answer: It depends on the purpose. Visa and embassy submissions need Certified plus Apostille; court filings need Legal plus Notarized; university applications need Certified Translation. Use the comparison table above, or describe your document and we will recommend the right service free of charge.

faqs.question: How fast can you deliver a certified translation?
faqs.answer: Standard turnaround is 24–72 hours depending on length and language. Express 24-hour service is available for all common languages, and same-day service can be arranged for urgent visa or embassy submissions in Delhi NCR.

faqs.question: What is the difference between certified, notarized and apostille?
faqs.answer: Certified includes our agency seal, signature and Certificate of Accuracy, and is accepted by most universities and many government bodies. Notarized adds a notary public attestation, often required for legal documents. Apostille adds Ministry of External Affairs authentication on top, required for use in Hague Convention countries.

faqs.question: Do you offer interpretation for live events?
faqs.answer: Yes — simultaneous, consecutive and whispered interpretation for conferences, courts, business meetings, diplomatic events and medical consultations. Equipment such as booths, headsets and microphones is available for larger events.

faqs.question: Do you charge more outside Delhi?
faqs.answer: No. Pricing is flat across India. A certified translation costs the same from Mumbai or Chennai as it does in Delhi. Courier delivery for hard copies is available on request; unusually bulky shipments may carry a clearly itemised courier charge.

faqs.question: How do I send documents if I am not in Delhi?
faqs.answer: Send clear scans or photographs by email or WhatsApp. We translate from the scans, email the soft copy, and courier the certified hard copy to any PIN code in India.

faqs.question: Which cities do you cover?
faqs.answer: We serve 150+ Indian cities across all states and union territories, with a physical office in Delhi NCR for walk-in submission.

faqs.question: Are your translations accepted by government departments and Indian courts?
